issues.description: Several bullets are marked as 'General background knowledge' (metrics, MVP items, checklist items). These are acceptable as general guidance, but some specific recommendations in the section would benefit from explicit KB citations that already exist in the knowledge base (e.g. audit/log fields, 'Pokrok v matematice', Minecraft licensing, image‑editing features in Windows/Photos).
issues.required_fix: Add targeted footnotes or cross‑references to the relevant KB excerpts: kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_page_8_1 for audit/log fields and 'Pokrok v matematice' workflows; kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_page_15_2 for Minecraft Education licensing note; kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_page_53_1 for image/background‑removal functionality in Paint/Photos.

issues.description: There is an inline '\\' inside the item 'orientační Q\\ \&A' which is an unnecessary linebreak command inside an \item and may cause LaTeX formatting issues.
issues.required_fix: Remove the '\\' and write 'orientační Q\&A nad sylabem ...' (escape the ampersand as already done).

issues.description: The recommended time plan gives durations but does not state ownership/deliverables or explicit success criteria per phase, which reduces operational clarity for guarantors.
issues.required_fix: Augment the time plan with brief deliverables and owners per phase (e.g. '4 týdny — definice požadavků a dat: owner = garant + IT; deliverable = scope doc & DPIA decision') or cross‑reference the implementation checklist/roles in section 4.1.5 or 9.2.

issues.description: The section mentions 'sběr metrik a logů (anonymizovaně)' but does not list the specific audit fields recommended elsewhere in the KB (prompt, model/service/version, datetime, validator, decision) found in the redesign checklist.
issues.required_fix: Either include the recommended audit/log fields directly in the section or add a cross‑reference (and citation) to the redesign checklist (kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_page_8_1) so readers know which fields to collect.

issues.description: The MVP scope and key functions are general; adding 1–2 concrete starter pilot examples (aligned with earlier chapters) would help guarantors pick an initial scenario.
issues.required_fix: Add short explicit examples for MVP choices such as starting with 'Pokrok v matematice' (training/exercise generation) or a Minecraft Education Hour of Code pilot, with appropriate citations (kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_page_8_1 and kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_page_15_2).
